data.narrative:
Tenna Systems is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $13.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peer companies spanning the defense tech sector—2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, which represent the most relevant benchmarks at similar or adjacent funding stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next stage, implies a valuation of $34M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A) yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B. The disparity reflects wide variance in capital intensity and market positioning within the defense-tech subsector.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $29M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $217M. This wide range reflects material uncertainty around growth trajectory, customer traction, and technology differentiation relative to the peer set. The stage-progression method produces more conservative output, while peer multiples are heavily influenced by the composition and recent funding activity of the comparable universe.
